name: Recast
description: Discard 1 or 2 other techniques, then draw that many.
prompt: Generate a single standalone illustration for an engraved nautical fantasy card game. Match reference's 19th century copperplate crosshatching, stippling, faded sepia-gold objects and deep navy watercolor foam, richly detailed antique naturalist field journal feel. Wide horizontal vignette, roughly 16:9, completely transparent outside irregular feathered ink silhouette. No parchment rectangle, no frame, no title, no lettering, no UI, no card face. Readable large centerpiece; detailed linework. Reference is style only, do not reproduce its knot. A graceful antique wooden fishing rod tip sweeps from the left; a long looping golden fishing line arcs across a navy wave and carries a small brass lure into the water at right. Dynamic casting motion, no hands.
